rules.text: no run starts once the arm's card time (its first device access to now) passes 112 minutes; at 120 the session ends after the run in progress (a started run is cut only by a stop); a stop touches the host's --stop-file (the host ends at its next launch boundary), never a kill

rests: each arm's first card command at least 40 minutes after our previous session on that box ended (on aifoundry1, either card)
window: G = each arm's booking on its day; last start G + 1:30, last end G + 3:30, each rounded up to the whole minute, inside the Pacific day; G at 20:29:00 PST or earlier
boxes: arm A on aifoundry3 after E202's card day there; arm B on aifoundry1 card 1 when aifoundry1 is the lab's (it was yielded to the model session's own matmul sweeps at 11:04 PST Mon 16 Nov 2026; arm B runs only if aifoundry1 comes back to the lab before its window closes, else its points are NO DATA); the two arms, on two boxes, may run at the same time
reads_only: dmcmd_audit_v2 GO with every send site READ before the first device access; no statistics reset, no set of any kind (TDP, threshold, clock, voltage), no reset, no power cycle, no firmware change; et-who, who, uptime and ps read before each session; the card's lock held for the session; every device process under a plain timeout 10; the host's package counter is not read; the owner waived the Discord post (his words, Sun 15 Nov 2026 10:22:36 PST: "don't worry about discord post, just use the machines")
